text_block_list.text: About a week before the Kikuka-sho.

After discussing it with Sakura Laurel, we 
decided to skip the Kikuka Sho. Instead—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I will certainly go observe, without fail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we make our plans right 
away? The Shinkansen train should be three 
hours before the race—...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, this news.

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
"Breaking news. Biwa Hayahide, who was 
scheduled to run in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), has announced in a press 
conference that she will be temporarily 
hospitalized."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san! A temporary 
hospitalization... were you injured 
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...No. I simply decided to focus on 
recovery so that I can take on the 
challenge in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to this year's intense heat, 
my condition has dropped a little. I'm 
hoping to get back on track at this time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm scheduled to be discharged on the day 
of the Kikuka-sho. After the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), there's the Arima Kinen with 
Brian, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're looking forward to it too, aren't 
you, Hayahide-chan? The sister showdown 
against Brian-chan, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder which one will win.

Together, Sakura Laurel and I can't help 
but feel growing anticipation for the 
battles to come. Yet on the other hand—

All sorts of comments were flying across 
the internet regarding Biwa Hayahide's 
temporary hospitalization.

text_block_list.name: Internet Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Why is Hayahide being hospitalized?" 
"She's just resting up for the Arima, 
she'll be fine."

text_block_list.name: Internet Comment
text_block_list.text:
"During the press conference, it felt like 
her muscles lacked tone." "Honestly, even 
Brian must be worried."

Overcast skies stretch across Kyoto 
Racecourse. When I headed to the Kikuka 
Sho with Sakura Laurel—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, there still hasn't been any 
update on Hayahide, huh... Even though she 
was supposed to be discharged today...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Liiike I said, it'll be on the news once 
they're discharged! More importantly, 
let's watch Brian!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
If it's Lady Brian, she will be fine. As 
long as it's Lady Brian, everything will 
be alright...!

The people in the stands that day were 
strangely restless and buzzing with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though Hayahide-chan properly 
explained at the press conference that it 
was 'to challenge it in peak condition.'"

Yet even though they know it in their 
hearts, an awkward atmosphere is 
contagious from one person to another.

Amidst the bizarre atmosphere, Narita 
Brian enters the gate—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The little sister is just fine! The 
little sister is just fine!! Narita Brian 
takes first place!!"

Ripping through the dark clouds that had 
hung over her, Narita Brian charged 
furiously across the finish line—...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Brian! Brian! Brian! Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Chants of 'Brian!' echo through the 
venue! This is the one and only strongest! 
The reigning greatest Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Brian-chan is amazing...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, a 7-length lead in the Kikuka Sho is 
just—

Yeah, winning the Kikuka Sho by seven 
lengths is just—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That as well, but... everyone around 
us, too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Briaaaan! You're so cool--!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: This is it! This is our Narita Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere now is completely different 
from before the race. Everyone is totally 
crazy about Brian-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I want to become strong enough to 
rewrite everything with my own legs, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I want to shine so bright that I won't be 
outdone by that brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Briaaan! Look over here! You're our 
strongest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did you hear about Narita Brian? 
Sounds like she's going down the royal 
road of mid-to-long distance!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll check after the concert. Ending 
this year with the Arima Kinen, and 
kicking off next year with the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
By next spring, do you think the concerns 
with my legs will be resolved?

The Tenno Sho (Spring) is the ultimate 
showdown for stayers. Sakura Laurel 
certainly has the talent for it, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once this leg of mine is fully 
healed, that is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if you can't run next 
year. Even if it has to be the year after 
next.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure—that girl will keep running ahead 
of me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To overtake them, you should challenge 
them only when you are fully prepared~âª

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will endure the winter and bloom in 
full glory come spring!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
...! Biwa Hayahide was discharged from the 
hospital on schedule!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's awesome! I mean, see~? There 
was nothing to worry about after all~!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Brian is doing great too. After the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), it's finally time for the 
Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text: ...Moving on to our next story.

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
...! In that case, we will be changing our 
schedule to bring you the following news 
report.

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news. Biwa Hayahide, who was 
running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
"Having suffered an injury to her left 
leg, she announced that 'all future race 
plans have been scrapped.'"

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
While a direct showdown with Narita Brian 
at the Arima Kinen was highly anticipated, 
those plans have now all been canceled.
